story: The company was founded by renowned professor and dancer Leonardo Martínez Moya. A group of former dancers and masters of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba, from different generations, came together to give birth to this project.

The objective is to promote, share and preserve the knowledge of traditional folkloric Cuban dances. For this group of masters it is an honour to work with passionate dancers and musicians from around the world who, through their love of Cuban culture, have joined them on this magical journey through dance, song and music. The company is directed by Giuliana Cassarisi.

It is also a tribute to the Cuban people, their culture, their diverse ethnicity, and the legacy of all the masters, dancers, musicians and artists before them who spread Cuban culture around the world. In Cuba, the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba has represented the island's heritage through dance and performance since 1962.

pillars.title: International dancers
pillars.text: The company brings together dancers from all over the world, united by their passion for Cuban dance and culture.

pillars.title: Traveling trainings
pillars.text: Every month we meet in a different city in Europe for an intensive training weekend.

pillars.title: Academic & choreographic training
pillars.text: A strong emphasis on the development of our members, with high-level academic and choreographic programmes.

pillars.title: International performances
pillars.text: We perform at festivals, cultural events and tours, highlighting the richness and diversity of Cuban culture.

pillars.title: Artistic collaborations
pillars.text: We collaborate with renowned artists, choreographers and musicians to create productions that blend tradition with modern expression.

pillars.title: Social & cultural integration
pillars.text: Workshops and activities that engage local communities wherever we perform, creating real opportunities for cultural exchange.

mission: The International Company of Cuban Dances is dedicated to preserving and promoting Cuban culture by safeguarding and sharing Cuba's artistic and cultural traditions through performances, workshops and international collaborations.

Education and training are at the heart of our work. We offer dedicated programmes for dancers, passing on Cuban dance techniques and the values of folklore to new generations across Europe and beyond.

We are also committed to the research and documentation of traditional Cuban dances, carefully recording choreographies, music and costumes to ensure their preservation and transmission for the future.

exchange.title: Cultural exchange with Cuba
exchange.text: A key objective is to foster integration and exchange between Cuba and other countries, through international festivals and collaborations with other dance companies, and to recognise and celebrate the African roots of Cuban culture. We are proud to be the official European representation of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba. With our Encuentros we travel to Havana to train with the maestros of the Conjunto and the Conjunto Ban Rarrá: two intensive weeks in 2024 and 2025, including the Conjunto's anniversary show.

paths.title: Academy
paths.text: The academy is open to everyone joining us for the first time. Study Afro-Cuban dances in depth at your own rhythm. Stay in the academy if your main goal is to train and grow as a dancer, or if you can't join every month.

paths.title: Company
paths.text: Become a member of the company and perform on stages across Europe. After at least three training weekends, the teachers decide whether you join the company or continue in the academy a little longer. Members commit to attending every month and rehearsing the choreographies.
